projectContent.text:
Inspired by the cult scene from Will Ferrell's Semi-Pro where he introduces the concept of ELE - Everybody Love Everybody, we created a 60s-style inclusive illustration. This design reflects the diversity of minorities and personas present in Israeli society, along with a Hebrew translation of ELE. Some elements of the design reference Gush Emunim an Israeli ultranationalist Orthodox Jewish right-wing movement dedicated to establishing Jewish settlements in the West Bank, Gaza Strip, and Golan Heights. We created a satirical version of this, calling it "Gush Metonim," which translates to "The Moderate Bloc" instead of "The Believers' Bloc."

Original pamphlet for “Gush Emunim”
